article.headline: Fairleigh Dickinson secures 78-66 win against NJIT
article.description: — Bol Agu’s 20 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson defeat NJIT 78-66 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Fairleigh Dickinson secures 78-66 win against NJIT
article.story: TEANECK, N.J. -- — Bol Agu’s 20 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson defeat NJIT 78-66 on Wednesday. Agu added six rebounds for the Knights (3-3). David Jevtic shot 4 of 10 from the field and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to add 15 points. J.R. Jacobs shot 3 of 7 from the field, including 1 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line to finish with 13 points. David Bolden led the Highlanders (1-6) in scoring, finishing with 17 points. Brandon Stores Jr. added 14 points and two steals for NJIT. Matheo Coffi finished with 13 points, six rebounds and two blocks. Up next Fairleigh Dickinson’s next game is Monday against Iona on the road. NJIT visits Boston College on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
